## `neuro.object.keys`

Static method on `Object`.

> Returns the names of the enumerable string properties and methods of an object.

## Signatures

```ts
keys(input: { o: object; prompt?: string }): Promise<string[]>
keys(input: { o: {}; prompt?: string }): Promise<string[]>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Object.keys` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
